nodes.label: Android value-parity test (ResourceParityTest)
rationale: Why it parses the XML files from disk instead of the compiled R class: [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar-proyek-snipset/2026-09-26 - c10-android-value-parity [ses_f20d53cb3ffe5CCxiKo7mIM1c4].md:L4578] "It parses the two XML files from disk with `javax.xml.parsers.DocumentBuilderFactory` rather than the compiled `R` class, because `R.string.*` cannot show both locales side by side."

Why its allowlist is 7 keys where the contract asked for 5: [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar-proyek-snipset/2026-09-26 - c10-android-value-parity [ses_f20d53cb3ffe5CCxiKo7mIM1c4].md:L4538] "The contract's test allowlist has 5 keys, which is arithmetically incompatible with the 17 identical keys: 5 + 8 defects = 13, leaving 4, and translating all 4 (including "Build SHA") is the only way a 5-key allowlist goes green."
